name: moodle-teaching-tools
description: Claude skills and a built-in Moodle connection for NCSU faculty: at-risk-student dashboards, resource-link audits, online course standards audits, and Moodle gradebook setup.

moodle_url.title: Moodle site address
moodle_url.description: The address in your browser when you are signed in to Moodle, up to .edu. It changes each academic year.

moodle_token.title: Moodle web services token
moodle_token.description: Your own token. Treat it like a password. Leave blank only if you already run the Moodle MCP server separately.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes to Moodle
allow_writes.description: Leave off to keep Claude read-only on live courses.
